info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Trust Services Management API
info.description: The Trust Services Management API enables businesses to update and manage trust services for consumers efficiently. This API facilitates modifications to existing trust service records, allowing organizations to respond swiftly to client requests or regulatory changes. Typical consumers include financial institutions and service providers that handle client trust services. Through this API, users can ensure compliance and maintain an up-to-date record of trust services offered to enhance customer trust and satisfaction.

patch.description: This endpoint allows you to update the details of a specific Trust Service identified by its unique resource ID (RES-100045). It accepts a PATCH request with the necessary data to modify the service attributes.

requestBody.description: The request body for updating resources in the Trust Services API. This body should contain the necessary fields to define the updates required for the specified resource.

200.description: The request was successfully processed and the resource was updated.
